_comment: Source recipes for tools/convert_models.py (Blender) and tools/fetch_models.sh. Frames: remap maps AC3D raw axes to Godot (+X right, +Y up, -Z nose). AC3D raw in the FlightGear F-16 is x aft, y up, z left (verified against the animation centres). body_remap maps the FlightGear body frame (x aft, y right, z up) used by XML offsets and animations. rules: [bucket, regex] on AC3D object names, first match wins, '_drop' removes the object, unmatched objects go to 'airframe'. anim: bucket -> FG animation object-name giving the hinge (center/axis/max from the XML). hinges: bucket -> hinge in body frame where the XML animation is commented out (center, axis, max_deg, property). offset_overrides: model name -> body offset that replaces the XML <offsets>. scale: meters per AC3D unit (no fit). extra_ac: [{path (relative to src), offset (body frame), bucket}] places extra AC3D files (rotor discs) with a forced bucket. A hinges entry with rotor: true is a spin axis (hub + axis) recorded in model_info rotors instead of control_surfaces.
